Clearly attach the foreground knee to its original hip, cross the two shins, then place foreground BOOT to RIGHT of far boot. Do not just widen same pose. BOTTOM RIGHT passing pose: far leg stands under pelvis and foreground knee swings forward with bent boot lifted clear. Exactly two legs, unchanged leg lengths. Preserve all upper body pixels and compact proportions, not four new faces. All four figures complete and separated, no cropping of crown/ponytail or boot, keep transparent margins. True transparent RGBA; no letters, diagram, arrows, floor, shadows, particles or additional hands.
